mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.game_id) FROM play_records pr WHERE pr.user_id = #{userId} AND pr.start_time >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND pr.start_time < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) AS totalGames, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_games ug WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} AND ug.status = '已完成' AND ug.completed_at >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND ug.completed_at < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) AS completedGames
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_achievements WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND unlocked_at >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND unlocked_at < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration), 0) FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND start_time < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.cover, ROUND(t.minutes / 60) AS hours FROM ( SELECT game_id, SUM(duration) AS minutes FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND start_time < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY game_id HAVING SUM(duration) > 0 ORDER BY minutes DESC, game_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) t JOIN games g ON g.id = t.game_id

SELECT COALESCE(mg.name, '其他') AS name, ROUND(SUM(pg.minutes) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(duration) FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND start_time < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)), 2) AS percent, ROUND(SUM(pg.minutes) / 60.0, 1) AS hours FROM ( SELECT game_id, SUM(duration) AS minutes FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND start_time < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY game_id HAVING SUM(duration) > 0 ) pg LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gr.game_id, MIN(gg.id) AS genre_id FROM game_genre_relations gr JOIN game_genres gg ON gg.id = gr.genre_id GROUP BY gr.game_id ) mgr ON mgr.game_id = pg.game_id LEFT JOIN game_genres mg ON mg.id = mgr.genre_id GROUP BY mg.name ORDER BY percent DESC

SELECT MONTH(start_time) AS month, ROUND(SUM(duration) / 60) AS hours FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AND start_time < DATE_ADD(MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY MONTH(start_time) ORDER BY month
SELECT id, user_id, year, favorite_game_id, total_play_time, play_style, achievements_count, snapshot_json, generated_at, created_at FROM yearly_reports WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND year = #{year}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yearly_reports (user_id, year, favorite_game_id, total_play_time, play_style, achievements_count, snapshot_json, generated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{year}, #{favoriteGameId}, #{totalPlayTime}, #{playStyle}, #{achievementsCount}, #{snapshotJson}, #{generatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE favorite_game_id = VALUES(favorite_game_id), total_play_time = VALUES(total_play_time), play_style = VALUES(play_style), achievements_count = VALUES(achievements_count), snapshot_json = VALUES(snapshot_json), generated_at = VALUES(generated_at)
